home.rail.title: Closing soon
home.why.title: The information gap is the real barrier.
home.why.lede: Students who already know where to look get in. Everyone else searches ten platforms, misses a deadline and never finds out what they qualified for. Meridian closes that gap.
home.why.1.title: One verified database
home.why.1.body: UWC, FLEX, Erasmus+, exchanges, summer schools, scholarships and youth programmes — checked, dated and written in plain language.
home.why.2.title: People who did it first
home.why.2.body: Every tutor and counsellor on Meridian has been through the programme they advise on. Not theory — the actual application.
home.why.3.title: Deadlines that find you
home.why.3.body: Requirements, opening dates and closing dates tracked for you, so nothing quietly expires while you are studying.
home.why.4.title: Built for students anywhere
home.why.4.body: Written for the documents you actually have, the grades you actually hold and the budgets families actually work with.

about.title: We are closing the information gap.
about.lede: Opportunities to study, compete and get funded abroad are scattered across thousands of websites. Meridian puts programmes, scholarships, universities, exam prep, tutors and counselling in one place, in English, Georgian and Arabic. We are based in Doha.
about.mission.title: Our mission
about.mission.body: In the US, sending high-achieving low-income students tailored information, at about $6 each, changed where they applied and enrolled (Hoxby & Turner). Information works. We collect what is scattered across the world, check it against official pages, and put a qualified person next to it.
about.vision.title: Where this goes
about.vision.body: One place where any student, in any country, can find a programme, a scholarship or a university, prepare for it, and apply without leaving the platform. Next: verified outcomes, published openly: score gains per prep hour, acceptances and scholarship money won.

pricing.fee.title: Pay per lesson. One transparent fee.
pricing.fee.body: Tutors set their own price and keep all of it. Meridian adds 10% on top for the platform — matching, scheduling, payments and support. You always see the full price before you pay.
pricing.faq.title: Questions about paying
pricing.faq.a1: Yes. Cancel from your account in one click. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for, and you are never charged again.
pricing.faq.q2: Which payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faq.a2: Visa and Mastercard debit and credit cards, issued by any bank in any country.
pricing.faq.q3: How does the 10% tutoring fee work?
pricing.faq.a3: A tutor who charges 20 ₾ is shown to you at 22 ₾. The tutor receives their full 20 ₾; the 2 ₾ keeps Meridian running. The fee is always shown before you pay.
pricing.faq.a4: You get a full refund automatically, including the Meridian fee, and an email letting you know.
pricing.faq.a5: Your full card number never reaches Meridian. Payments are processed by licensed providers over encrypted connections; we only ever see the card brand and last four digits for your receipt.
